characterization_methods.key_findings: Equiaxed polygonal austenite grains with abundant annealing twins; grains are fully recovered.
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe the microstructure of annealed fully austenite low-density steel

characterization_methods.key_findings: Light grey austenite matrix (γ) containing dark, thin, elongated ferrite grains roughly aligned with RD.
characterization_methods.purpose: Observe the microstructure of annealed austenite-based duplex low-density steel

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Abundant annealing twins observed within fully recovered austenite grains

interfaces.interface_notes: Optical micrograph shows equiaxed polygonal austenite grains with straight, parallel-sided annealing twin bands (50 µm scale bar).
Elongated ferrite grains are embedded in the austenite matrix and roughly aligned with RD.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Annealing controls the microstructure of Fe–Mn–C–Al low-density steel, yielding either fully austenite or austenite-based duplex (ferrite + austenite) microstructures.

phases_present.morphology: equiaxed polygonal grains containing straight, parallel-sided annealing twins

structures.overall_structure: Annealed fully austenite (single-phase γ) low-density steel with abundant annealing twins and fully recovered grains; fully austenite composition range: Mn 12–30 wt%, Al 5–12 wt%, C 0.6–1.2 wt%.

phases_present.morphology: dark, thin, elongated worm-/lentil-shaped grains roughly aligned with RD

structures.overall_structure: Annealed austenite-based duplex (mixture of austenite matrix and elongated ferrite grains along rolling direction); duplex composition range: Al 5–10 wt%, Mn 5–30 wt%, C 0.4–0.7 wt%.
